# Miro

> Miro is an intelligent collaborative workspace platform that combines AI-powered workflows, team collaboration tools, and business solutions to transform how teams work together.

Miro provides a suite of products designed for modern teams including AI Workflows for process automation, customer journey mapping, design workshops, and leadership solutions. The platform emphasizes collaborative AI integration and process optimization across organizations.

## Key Topics

- AI Workflows
- Collaborative AI
- Process Automation
- Customer Journey Mapping
- Design Workshops
- Team Collaboration
- AI Integration
- Business Operations
- Leadership Strategy
- Canvas 2026
- Intelligent Workspace
- Workflow Automation
- Team Productivity
- Innovation
- Multi-city Conference

## AI Products & Platform

- [Miro AI Workflows](https://miro.com/products/ai-workflows): Automate processes from brainstorms to scalable standards using AI-powered workflow automation
- [Miro Collaborative AI Workspace](https://miro.com/ai/your-ai): Connect AI models and boost team productivity through collaborative AI integration
- [AI Playbooks](https://miro.com/ai-playbooks): Comprehensive guide for AI workflows, planning, and process transformation strategies

## Core Products

- [Customer Journey Mapping Tools](https://miro.com/products/customer-journeys): AI-powered customer journey mapping and pain point analysis for teams
- [Design Workshop Tools](https://miro.com/products/design-workshops): Collaborative problem-solving tool that accelerates team decisions through AI-powered workshops

## Business Solutions

- [Leadership Solution](https://miro.com/solutions/leadership): AI strategy workspace for executive teams including portfolio management and goal tracking
- [Business Operations Solution](https://miro.com/solutions/business-operations): Process optimization and bottleneck analysis for smart operations management

## Events & Community

- [Canvas 2026 Conference](https://canvas.miro.com): Multi-city innovation summit with registration in San Francisco, London, Sydney, and Tokyo
